# Patches added in this fork

<!-- Generated by tools/gen-fork-patch-index.py from each patch's manifest.toml and README STATUS banner. Do not edit by hand: change the patch, then re-run the script. -->

This fork ([ethansm/Kotor-Patch-Manager](https://github.com/ethansm/Kotor-Patch-Manager)) adds 49 patches on top of upstream [LaneDibello/Kotor-Patch-Manager](https://github.com/LaneDibello/Kotor-Patch-Manager). Almost all of them target KOTOR II (Steam/Aspyr); the GOG builds are mostly address-mapped but not played.

Each patch folder has a README with a STATUS banner (track, version, requirements, known limits, install notes). Read it before installing.

**Tracks:** *Shippable* is meant for normal play. *Experimental* works but is still changing or has open issues. *Diagnostic* is a probe or measurement build: don't install it for normal play.

**Providers** are shared libraries that other patches build on (`requires`). KPM installs them like any patch; install a provider before the patches that need it.

| Track | Patches |
|---|---|
| Diagnostic | 6 |
| Experimental | 8 |
| Shippable | 35 |

## Rendering and performance

| Patch | What it does | Track | Version | Requires | Builds |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [K2 Engine Perf](../Patches/K2EnginePerf/README.md) | Caches the per-frame `GlobalMemoryStatus` call (250 ms TTL) to cut Wine/Proton CPU overhead, plus an optional per-pass QPC profiler (`pass_profile`, default off). | Experimental | 0.2.0-dev | none | Steam |
| [K2 Fog Distance](../Patches/K2FogDistance/README.md) | Scales each KOTOR II area's distance fog start and end (default 200%, up to 400%, or 0% = No Fog) so distant scenery stays visible. | Shippable | 0.1.1-dev | none | Steam |
| [K2 Frame Pacing](../Patches/K2FramePacing/README.md) | Stops KOTOR II from spinning a full CPU core while the window is minimized, caps the frame rate while the game is in the background, and offers an optional FPS cap that sleeps instead of busy-waiting. | Shippable | 0.1.0-dev | none | Steam |
| [K2 Grass Draw Distance](../Patches/K2GrassDrawDistance/README.md) | Extends KOTOR II grass render and octree build distance from the vanilla 15-30 m fade (hard-clipped at 25.1 m by the 0.40 alpha test) to a configurable 120-150 m, and trims grass that is fully hidden. | Shippable | 0.1.10-dev | none | Steam |
| [K2 Shadow Distance](../Patches/K2ShadowDistance/README.md) | Raises the distance at which KOTOR II objects cast stencil shadows, from the vanilla 35 m up to 100 m, with 35 m as the default so vanilla behaviour is kept until changed. | Shippable | 0.1.0-dev | none | Steam |
| [K2 Texture Memory Release](../Patches/K2TextureMemoryRelease/README.md) | Frees the CPU-side copy of TPC textures after they are uploaded to OpenGL, as the engine already does for TGA textures, which saves memory in a 32-bit process | Shippable | 1.0.0 | none | Steam |
